index.heading: Front matter — issue identity
index.summary: PBI-4471, 'Discover brand acceptance — authorization parser and routing table', with its source URL.

index.heading: Description
index.summary: Delivered Discover as an accepted brand at authorization: PAN-range recognition for Discover BINs 601100-601109 and 644000-659999, a new discover_handler, and routing-table entries pointing Discover traffic at the DCI endpoint. EXPLICITLY OUT OF SCOPE: settlement reconciliation, deferred to PBI-4602 because the recon file format change required separate network certification.

index.heading: Acceptance criteria
index.summary: Discover PANs resolve to card_brand=DISCOVER; discover_handler dispatches to the DCI endpoint; routing-table reload requires no deploy; no regression in Mastercard or Visa dispatch.

index.heading: Comments
index.summary: Certification found co-badged Discover/Diners cards are NOT distinguishable by PAN range alone — raised as a known limitation rather than blocking delivery, with the network indicating an explicit brand indicator would follow in a later mandate. Closing comment reiterates settlement reconciliation remains untouched.
